question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**flows**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage refers to the subject i.e. "carpets."
 
• **Now, the blank 1 will imply how the river ganga passes past the town of Mirzapur.**
 
• Thus, the correct word to use for the movement of river Ganga is "flows."
 
 
• "Flows" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it refers to the movement of a liquid or gas.(बहना)
 
• Example: The river flows north from this point.
 
 
 
• The other given options are not suitable for the given blank.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The verb "spreads" would imply something becoming wider or more extensive, but not necessarily moving in a particular direction.(फैलता)
 
• "Grows" would suggest something increasing in size or quantity, but not necessarily moving at all.(बढ़ना)
 
• "Sets" would imply something becoming fixed or stationary, rather than moving.(स्थापित करना)
